content:
Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the central angle of the upper semicircle is
\[
\angle AOB=180^\circ.
\]

The shaded sector lies between the two blue radii. The unshaded angles adjacent to it are \(40^\circ\) and \(30^\circ\), so its central angle is
\[
180^\circ-40^\circ-30^\circ=110^\circ.
\]

Thus its area is \(\frac{110}{360}\) of the disk’s area. Because the point is chosen uniformly,
\[
P=\frac{\frac{110}{360}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac{110}{360}
=\boxed{\frac{11}{36}}.
\]
